support_boundary: IR ownership covers paired checked-in Objective-C 3 IR expectation files for recovery positive sources: function definitions, return values, selector constants, runtime dispatch calls, literal/global initializer IR, branch/control-flow IR, nil-elision markers, fast-path/non-fast-path dispatch markers, and accepted-source IR shape. Native lowering_dispatch/*.dispatch-ir.expect.txt marker files are provenance for legacy native dispatch-lowering markers unless a canonical IR owner explicitly claims them.
retired_surface_rule: generated-only IR rows, evidence-log IR rows, migration-only IR rows, old-mode IR rows, gate IR rows, retired route IR rows, compatibility IR rows, native .m IR claims, dispatch-ir marker claims without canonical Objective-C 3 source pairing, and directory-label-only IR claims are canonical rejection, strict-error, absent-support, or provenance-only evidence
